body.text: {param:who} has been at me about the schooling of {param:town}, by every post and at a length I would not have thought the Crown could afford.
I have given way. The town is to see to its learning, and you will hear of the building when there is a building to hear of.
I tell you because it was not your letter that moved me, and I would not have you think it was.

tone.text: As to the schooling of {param:town}, I am {choice}.

options.text: glad of it, whoever moved you
sorry you did not write to me first
